svg.title: MS-HAB granularity experiment: Contract and Policy layers
svg.desc: Five parameterized contracts bound to 53 concrete RL checkpoint policies.
svg.text: 5 reusable symbolic interfaces · inputs / preconditions / effects / deletes
53 stored RL checkpoint policies · each has exactly one EXECUTES connection
PG = prepare_groceries · ST = set_table · TH = tidy_house
Only relation: Policy —EXECUTES→ Contract · no Policy-to-Policy edges
